overviewHtml:
AI-powered features consume AI Units, and a few heavy users can use up a shared budget before anyone notices. Teams need a way to cap consumption per person.

What you get

  • Monitoring of per-user AI Units consumption from billing events in Grail
  • Daily quota check against a threshold you define
  • Automatic restriction of access to AI-powered features when the threshold is exceeded
  • Email notification and business events for each enforcement
prereqsHtml:
• Dynatrace platform with Account Management permissions
  • storage:events:write permission for the workflow actor (to ingest business events)
  • Email connector enabled in your Dynatrace environment
  • Billing events data available in Grail (dt.system.events)
getStartedHtml:
You need a Dynatrace environment with Account Management permissions and the Email connector.

  1. Upload the workflow in Dynatrace Workflows
  2. Set your daily quota threshold and notification recipients
  3. Grant the workflow actor permission to write business events
  4. Activate the trigger
